briefHtml:
NAV S$10,075,493 - reported -0.88% (stale baseline), recorded -0.07% d/d; lowest print of the drawdown

  • Biggest mover: silver -6.0% to $40.59 futures - lowest settle of the year (spot $40.76, 14-month low, -39% in 13 weeks); leveraged IBKR line back to ~1.65x, equity ~S$36.7k
  • The one thing: Monday's Trump-brokered rally round-tripped in one session - NVDA -5.9%, SOXX -8%, ANT closed below its $83 IPO price, gold/silver fresh 14-month lows - and USTR teed up new Section 301 tariffs on China, the EU, Japan and 13 others for Tuesday night (US). October PCE lands 8:30am ET today with the Dec 9 hike 97% priced, into a Thanksgiving-thinned tape.

Markets

  • US Tue: SPX 7,201 -0.50%; Nasdaq 23,734 -1.48%; Dow 50,019 +0.85% (value rotation: Kohl's +19.5%, Dollar Tree +11.2%); NVDA $155.38 -5.86%; ANT ~$82 -6.5% (below $83 IPO); SOXX -8%, ADI -17%, MU ~-10%; DELL -11% then beat (rev $54.94bn +103%, EPS $9.45, AI backlog $132.3bn) and still fell after hours; HPE -16% on a beat-and-raise; VIX 26.36; 10y ~4.91-4.92%; consumer confidence 103.3 vs 92.2 consensus
  • Metals: gold futures $3,550-3,554 -2.7-2.8% (14-month low); silver futures $40.59 -6.0%, lowest settle of the year; spot silver $40.76 (-39% in 13 weeks, steepest since Lehman); BTC $59,500; WTI $81.45 +1.6%
  • Asia Tue: STI 4,958.87 +0.10% (SG Q3 GDP beat; 2026 forecast raised to 6.0%; inflation 1.9%); HSI 22,220 -0.73%; Tencent HK$341.60 -0.70%; Xiaomi HK$26.50 -3.71% on 232.8M shares (Q3 imminent); DBS +1.3% morning (close not yet in Yahoo)
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2891; USDCNY ~6.65; USDHKD ~7.84

Flags

  • 8 critical flags - all 5-session windows anchored to 11-17 closes, mislabeled in a day (Tencent 341.60 vs 376.00 exact; Xiaomi 26.50 vs 29.70 exact; silver -7.7% implies ~$43.98 baseline, plausible)
  • GDX -10.3% / SILJ -13.2% / SLVP -13.0% are plausible 5-session windows including Tuesday's -6% silver day; listed book -5.30% is the same artefact; recorded NAV -0.07% d/d is the truth
  • DBS dropped off the flag list (5-session move only ~-3%). L46.SI Yahoo 404 - 40th session

Insider trades

  • DBS Group (D05.SI): BlackRock filed Form 3 - ceasing to be a substantial shareholder (below 5%); notice dated 16.11.2026, broadcast 18-Nov-2026; share count in the PDF, not the summary. Institutional supply on SG banks, on tape SGX
  • Nothing else for held names (SGX API now 401, 11th day; Wing Tai pause 13 sessions; no HKEX filings for Tencent/SMIC/Xiaomi; US holdings are ETFs)

Congress trades

  • Week to Nov 23: 50 transactions filed by 8 members - Armstrong (R-OK) 23 (largest: Idaho revenue bond buy up to $1.0M), Donalds (R-FL) 8, Rulli (R-OH) 6, Kean (R-NJ) 6, Boozman (R-AR) 4 CapitolExposed
  • Nov 14-21: 21 trades, 18 sells vs 3 buys - Donalds sold WBD + NFLX, bought MSFT; Rulli sold ZTS/COST/LITE, bought MSFT; Kean sold MSFT ($15-50K); Sewell sold TPR. Donalds is the FL-19 filer behind the 11/17 batch Congress Stock Tracker

Trump / policy

  • New Section 301 tariff proposals due Tuesday night (US): EU, China, Mexico, Japan + 12 others over excess manufacturing capacity; rumored up to +7.5% - recreates duties the Supreme Court struck down in February POLITICO
  • China extends its pause on additional rare-earth/mineral export controls to keep the truce (the Jan 10 cliff softens) BusinessMirror/Bloomberg
  • Fed: NY Fed's Williams - inflation too high, still work to do; futures 97% for a 25bp Dec 9 hike, 3% tail for 50bp; Ackman - the Fed is about to make another mistake on Dec 9 BullionVault
  • October PCE today 8:30am ET + Q3 GDP 2nd est; US closed Thu, 1pm ET close Fri
  • Trump (11/17): US will catch China on rare earths within 10 months Yahoo Finance
  • AI capex credibility: Dell's $132.3bn-backlog blowout got sold; HPE's beat-and-raise fell 16% - prints do not matter this week

Risk

  • Silver line (est., $40.59 x 1.2891): collateral ~S$92,985; loan ~S$56,240; equity ~S$36,745; ratio ~1.65x (Monday's 1.76x relief fully reversed); -$1 silver = -S$2,291 equity; ~$33 stress zone only $7.60 below
  • ANT below its $83 IPO removes the private-AI-demand corroboration; event stack in 24h: 301 tariffs + PCE + holiday tape + Dec 9 hike 97% priced
  • DBS 2.0% of NW with BlackRock exiting above-5% holder status; FX ~35% non-SGD (USDHKD ~7.84 peg edge); metals cluster still the dominant risk factor

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Real assets (20%): capitulation deepening - silver lowest settle of the year, miners -10% to -13% over five sessions; trigger stays mechanical: 2-3-session gold hold ~$3,500-3,550 through PCE + holiday before any unlevered tranche; silver line gets nothing
  • AI bottlenecks (15%, 0% deployed): NVDA a whisker above the $150-155 zone; ANT below $83 cracks the thesis corroboration; Dell proved prints do not matter this week - staged tranche stays parked until a 2-3-session base or the Dec 9 FOMC clears
  • Defense (15%): 10y 4.91-4.92% - the 5.20% gate is 28-29bp away; hot PCE + hawkish Dec 9 could deliver it; deploy TLT in size AT the gate only

trumpWatch.title: New Section 301 tariffs teed up for Tuesday night
trumpWatch.detail: USTR Greer to announce proposed tariff hikes on the EU, China, Mexico, Japan and 12 other trading partners over 'excess manufacturing capacity' - recreating duties the Supreme Court struck down in February; rumored up to +7.5%. Direct hit-list relevance for China/HK tech and Asia supply chains.

trumpWatch.title: China extends rare-earth export-control pause
trumpWatch.detail: Beijing extended its pause on additional export controls on rare earths and critical minerals to keep the trade truce - the Jan 10 cliff this brief has been flagging now softens, pending written confirmation.

trumpWatch.title: Fed hawks into PCE day; Dec 9 hike 97% priced
trumpWatch.detail: NY Fed's Williams: economy strong, inflation too high, 'still work to do' raising rates. Futures price 97% for a 25bp Dec 9 hike with a 3% tail for 50bp. Ackman: the Fed 'is about to make another mistake on December 9th'. October PCE lands today 8:30am ET with Q3 GDP (2nd est).

trumpWatch.title: AI capex credibility breaks: Dell blowout gets sold
trumpWatch.detail: Dell beat hugely after Tuesday's close - revenue $54.94bn +103%, adj EPS $9.45 +265%, AI orders $60.2bn, AI backlog a record $132.3bn - and the stock still fell in after-hours on margin-sustainability questions, after dropping 11% in the session. HPE fell 16% on a beat-and-raise. Prints do not matter this week.

trumpWatch.title: ANT closes below its $83 IPO price
trumpWatch.detail: Anthropic fell 6.5% Tuesday to just under $82 - first close below the $83 IPO price since last week's record $107.3bn debut. NVDA gave back 5.9% of Monday's +31.6% Trump-brokered surge; SOXX -8%.

trumpWatch.title: Trump: US will catch China on rare earths in 10 months
trumpWatch.detail: Trump (11/17): the US is producing rare earths 'at a level that we've never made before' and will catch China within 10 months; he looks forward to APEC in China and expects Xi to raise Taiwan first.
